quests.title: Clear the Streets
quests.start_text: The Business Zombies are everywhere around here -- still in their suits, still walking their old commute. Could you thin them out? Thirty should make this corner safe enough for the others.
quests.progress_text: Defeat 30 Business Zombies in SHIBUYA and report to YUKA in the Live House SEVEN.
quests.complete_text: You did it... the street outside feels quieter already. Here, take this. It's our band shirt -- wear it to our next show, once there is one.

objectives.token_desc: A company ID badge, torn from a Business Zombie.

giver.hook: Is there anything I can do for you, YUKA?
giver.after_accept: Thank you. Please be careful out there.

quests.title: Safe Passage
quests.start_text: The Honey Zombies can sense people from a long way off. Anyone trying to reach this shelter walks straight into them. Would you deal with thirty of them?
quests.progress_text: Defeat 30 Honey Zombies in SHIBUYA and report to APG in the Live House SEVEN.
quests.complete_text: Thanks to you, people can reach us now. Take this shirt -- the black one's my favourite.

objectives.token_desc: A glittering hairpin from a Honey Zombie.

giver.hook: What can I do to help, APG?
giver.after_accept: Thank you! They're drawn to the living, so watch your back.
giver.turnin: The way here is safe. (Turn in)

quests.title: Stray Dogs
quests.start_text: I'm heading out to look for survivors, but the Undead Dogs pick up every trail. Could you take care of thirty of them while I search?
quests.progress_text: Defeat 30 Undead Dogs in SHIBUYA and report to RYO in the Live House SEVEN.
quests.complete_text: No dogs on my heels this time -- I even found two people hiding in a shop. This guitar was going to waste backstage. It's yours.

objectives.token_desc: A collar with a name tag nobody will read again.

giver.hook: Need a hand out there, RYO?
giver.after_accept: Great. I'll go and look for survivors, then.
giver.turnin: The dogs won't follow you now. (Turn in)

quests.title: Patching the Walls
quests.start_text: Every attack weakens this place somewhere. The Cunning Ghouls carry the kind of scrap we could use for repairs -- could you bring me fifteen pieces?
quests.progress_text: Collect 15 Repair Materials from Cunning Ghouls in SHIBUYA and bring them to YU-SUKE in the Live House SEVEN.
quests.complete_text: Perfect, this will hold the walls for a good while. Here -- every fan should have one of these.

objectives.token_desc: Scrap metal and cable a Cunning Ghoul was carrying. Good for patching walls.

giver.after_accept: You're a lifesaver. I'll keep up the patrols meanwhile.
giver.turnin: Here are the repair materials. (Turn in)

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.start_text: The Sly Ghouls kept a little of their wits -- they circle, they wait, they strike when nobody's watching. Take out thirty of them so we can search for food in peace.
quests.progress_text: Defeat 30 Sly Ghouls in SHIBUYA and report to SHOHEI in the Live House SEVEN.
quests.complete_text: That gave us room to breathe. You know what, take my drums. Keep the beat going out there.

objectives.token_desc: A long, hooked claw from a Sly Ghoul.

giver.after_accept: Thanks. Don't let them get behind you.
giver.turnin: The Sly Ghouls are dealt with. (Turn in)

quests.title: The King of the Deaders
quests.start_text: The band trusts you now, and so do I. At the heart of this plague is a beast the Deaders gather around, on the far plaza to the north-east: the Deader Rex. Please... put it to rest.
quests.progress_text: Defeat the Deader Rex on SHIBUYA's north-east plaza and report to Kanna in the Live House SEVEN.
quests.complete_text: You did it. The air feels lighter already... Please accept this. Our friend the mascot would want you to have it.

objectives.token_desc: A fragment of ancient bone from the Deader Rex.

giver.hook: The band trusts me now, Kanna.
giver.accept: I'll face the Deader Rex. (Accept quest)
giver.after_accept: May the gods walk with you.
giver.turnin: The Deader Rex is at rest. (Turn in)
